text:
anna: customer on Android hit duplicated/garbled chat after switching from cellular->wifi. sampleapp trace attached.

ben: hmm. did the client reconnect or just TCP handoff?

carla: capture shows abrupt conn close then new conn. proxy in front seems to replay a buffered tail. events look like partial JSON across two SSE events.

mike: can you paste the raw stream piece?

carla: heres the excerpt:

```
event: message\ndata: {\"id\":\"m42\",\"seq\":1,\"part\":\"Hel\"}\n\n--conn close--\n\nevent: message\ndata: {\"id\":\"m42\",\"seq\":2,\"part\":\"lo\"}\n\nevent: message\ndata: {\"id\":\"m42\",\"seq\":2,\"part\":\"lo\"}\n
```

carla: second seq arrives twice because proxy replayed buffered bytes. client ended up applying packet twice so message became "Hellolo" in some runs.

anna: which SDKs affected?

carla: Android sampleapp and node CLI both mis-apply; Go client deduped ok.

ben: sounds like cross-SDK parity bug. we should: (1) require dedupe by (id, seq) tuple; (2) buffer partial event data until full JSON parse succeeds; (3) add TTL for in-progress messages to prevent leak.

mike: agreed. I'll own Node/Android parser diffs and tests. add unit tests that inject repeated fragments.

anna: carla, can you add a minimal repro to sampleapp that flips network and forces proxy replay? keep it opt-in.

carla: yes, using --simulate-replay flag. local command:

```
./sampleapp/mobile --simulate-replay --seed=11
```

carla: will upload pcap + logs here after I run a few times.

ben: we should also make server include a resume-token header on reconnect and document that clients must be defensive against duplicate fragments.

mike: implemented lightweight patch: client keeps a set of completed (id,seq) for the session; ignore duplicates. also buffer data across SSE boundary until JSON.parse succeeds. will add ttl=30s to cleanup partials.

ci-bot: build triggered for branch fix/mobile-sse-dedupe (job #4892).

anna: add changelog note in SDK release and update sampleapp troubleshooting page with network-handOff guidance.

carla: uploaded repro artifacts: pcap + sampleapp log (link). running flaky CI job now.

mike: PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1214. awaiting tests.

anna: great. please coordinate customer follow-up once we have a verified fix.
